paths.description:

advanced into the feature; the rest stay pending.

agent_loop_id.description:

against this loop before responding.

CappedView_Value.description:

ErrorResponse.description:
Runtime and documentation envelope for every error response. Success
payloads keep using `ApiEnvelope<T>`; errors always carry `data: null`
and a populated `error`.

EvaluateBody.description:
Evaluate a filter expression against an arbitrary JSON record without
persisting anything. Useful for validating query semantics before use.

download.description: When true, answer as a file download instead of the JSON envelope.

PageView_Value.description: One page of a list response.

QueryBody.description:
Wire shape of the query endpoints: filters (basic + advanced
expressions) plus sort / pagination overrides.

RunAgentLoopBody.description:
Wire body of `/agent-loops/{id}/run` and `/stream`: the flattened
`AgentLoopConfig` fields plus the loop input.

checkpoint_message_interval.description:
Checkpoint every N appended conversation messages (`None` disables
the message-count backstop). Wired through to
`AgentLoopConfig::checkpoint_message_interval`.

ScriptExecuteBody.description:
Wire shape of `/scripts/execute` and `/scripts/validate`: mirrors
`wf_api::ScriptExecuteParams` with deserializable field types.
